actionConfiguration.body:
INSERT INTO documents (
    company_id,
    warehouse_id,
    created_by_user_id,
    document_type,
    status,
    document_number,
    document_date,
    currency_code,
    note,
    subtotal_amount,
    tax_amount,
    discount_amount,
    total_amount,
    paid_amount
)
SELECT
    {{appsmith.store.companyId}},
    {{NewCountWarehouseSelect.selectedOptionValue}},
    {{appsmith.store.userId}},
    'INVENTORY_COUNT',
    'COUNTING',
    CONCAT(
        'INV-',
        YEAR({{moment(NewCountDateInput1.selectedDate || moment()).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}),
        '-',
        LPAD(
            COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(d.document_number, 5) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1,
            5,
            '0'
        )
    ),
    {{moment(NewCountDateInput1.selectedDate || moment()).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}},
    'EUR',
    {{NewCountNoteInput.text || null}},
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0,
    0
FROM documents d
WHERE d.company_id = {{appsmith.store.companyId}}
  AND d.document_type = 'INVENTORY_COUNT'
  AND d.document_number LIKE CONCAT(
      'INV-',
      YEAR({{moment(NewCountDateInput1.selectedDate || moment()).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}),
      '-%'
  );
